mutations.name: drop-fencing
mutations.why: commit no longer compares the claim token: a stale holder can commit after another worker did

mutations.name: drop-fairness
mutations.why: nothing forces a worker holding a claim to ever commit or abort

mutations.name: token-bumped-twice
mutations.why: a claim bumps the fencing token by two (the code and a trigger both increment it), leaving the range TypeOK states

mutations.name: no-terminal-stutter
mutations.why: a finished system has no step left: TLC reports the end state as a deadlock
